power.method: 5000mAh (base) up to 15000mAh battery (up to 280 days); USB-C fast charging; optional 3W/7W solar

features: color / smart / infrared night vision modes
release_notes: Separate 'Cell PT 2C' and 'Cell PT 4G' models exist as distinct SKUs. Night-vision distance, focal length and sensor not stated on official sources. Corrected 2026-10-30 against the official Imou spec sheet: field_of_view_deg "pan 360 / tilt" -> 88 H / 45 V / 107 D; pan 330 / tilt 90 (feature "360 pan & tilt" -> 330 pan / 90 tilt); added night-vision range 20 m, sensor 1/2.8" CMOS, 3.6 mm lens, max 15 fps and model code IPC-K9E-3T0WE.

frigate.notes: 100% wire-free battery camera — it sleeps between events and does not expose a continuous local RTSP stream, so Frigate/local-NVR use is not supported. Recording is via the Imou Life app + cloud and on-device microSD.
